algorithm: PPO clipped policy gradient with GAE, tanh Gaussian actions
selection: lexicographic: all acceptance checks, largest absolute hold peak in cm, sum of absolute hold peaks in cm, hold MAE, reward; test once after selection. Failed candidates remain ineligible.
training_seed_sampling: 50% steady hold, 25% near-target, 25% all train; no validation/test seeds
training_credit: paired RL reward minus same-initial-state baseline reward; dense differential penalty on squared absolute worst two-sided peak excursion in cm x100; gamma .995, GAE lambda .98
initialization: tanh((-0.05*raw_error-0.4*raw_speed)/0.8)*0.8; identified on train-only feasibility rollouts; PPO updates all network parameters
limitations: Model-based simulation only, not evidence of water performance
12s rollout extrapolates a model trained on 3s windows; repeated source development limits independence
Forward state is held constant; no future recorded commands or sensors
200ms actuator lock is an unverified assumption; sensor delay is not explicitly reproduced
Dynamics frozen from older data; current controller changes are simulated, not refitted
No online learning, new robot data collection or firmware modification

goal_assessment.goal: less than or equal to 2 cm maximum excursion during depth hold
